Both nations aim to achieve a $200 billion bilateral trade milestone together.

items.title: Steps likely to safeguard FCV tobacco farmers
items.summary: The government is currently investigating ways to protect the interests of FCV tobacco farmers. On July 25, a ministry team traveled to Andhra Pradesh to review the ongoing market climate. Their discussions emphasized strategies to support growers while ensuring the industry's stability. Additional Secretary Nitin Kumar Yadav reassured farmers about ongoing oversight, underscoring the government's commitment to considering effective protective measures.

items.title: Global wheat rally revives India's export prospects as government allows 5 million tonnes of wheat exports after a four-year ban
items.summary: With global wheat prices soaring, Indian wheat stands to benefit from new export avenues. India, possessing ample wheat reserves, has set the stage for exports through 2026. Current market dynamics, bolstered by increased freight costs and worries over worldwide crop yields, have triggered a price surge. As a result, Indian wheat prices now align favorably for exports to Bangladesh. Additionally, wholesale wheat prices in Delhi reflect this upward trend.

items.title: Crypto exchanges to collect tax residency, ID details of users under new CBDT framework
items.summary: India now requires crypto exchanges to collect user tax residency details. Digital asset intermediaries must share transaction data annually with tax authorities. This aligns with the OECD's global Crypto Asset Reporting Framework. The Central Board of Direct Taxes issued a detailed compliance framework for reporting. Data sharing with participating jurisdictions begins next financial year.

items.title: Tax filers scramble to fix foreign asset disclosures: I-T portal data & SMS alerts prompt review of overseas holdings before July 31
items.summary: Taxpayers are receiving alerts about undeclared foreign assets before the July 31 deadline. The tax department has uploaded foreign asset data, prompting disclosures and professional help. Lapses stem from ignorance, negligence, or conscious concealment of overseas accounts and properties. Some taxpayers are seeking immunity under a fast-track disclosure scheme for eligible cases. Reconciling discrepancies with past filings and underlying records is now essential for compliance.

items.title: CCI avoiding suo motu probes to prevent conflict of interest
items.summary: The Competition Commission of India avoids initiating suo motu cases due to potential conflicts. This regulator now exercises restraint in sectors with existing sectoral regulators. The commission has disposed of 1,237 out of 1,375 anti-trust cases received. A settlement amount of Rs 20.24 crore was imposed in the Android Smart TV matter. This amount was calculated based on relevant Indian turnover and mitigating factors.
